experiments_done.verdict: NO translator-v1. Whitening buys decisiveness (sig-cos 0.885 -> 0.705 best) but pays more accuracy than it earns: sensor noise is amplified in the floored null directions before the cavity sees it. Phase spread alone is decisiveness-positive, accuracy-neutral-to-negative.

experiments_done.diagnosis: byte-spectrum encoding has no character locality: raw-NN on corrupted spectra also 0.050 (chance); cosine to true question 0.464 < best wrong 0.772; 10% char drop -> 0.200. Under modal-native degradation (40% modes zeroed) cavity selection = 0.700 vs raw-NN 0.350: the cavity completes in its own space; the TEXT DOOR is the failure, not the cavity.

expD.gate: FAIL both halves (packet acc < raw; packet tokens 8.4x raw)
failure_dissection: Token economics: framing + 32 complex deltas + 4 prose LUT meanings = ~917 prompt tokens vs 93 for raw prose. A translator 8.4x the cost of the thing it replaces is not a translator.

9/16 packet completions EMPTY with tokens_completion=1: immediate-stop artifact — under stop=[newline] the 4B model answers the long structured packet with a leading newline. All NETSTORM + all HIGHFLOW packets emptied, plus 1 CALM.

Even when it answered (7 trials), the model did not reliably follow the key: DCALM2 answered THERMAL with CALM top-match; DCALM0 answered CALM despite THERMAL top-match. At 4B, a 900-token numeric packet is a swamp, not a lookup.

The cavity-side key is mostly sound: LUT top-match by delta cosine correct on 12/16 (NETSTORM 4/4, HIGHFLOW 4/4, THERMAL 3/4, CALM 2/4; CALM/THERMAL boundary soft in delta space). The failure is model-side CONSUMPTION of the packet as formatted, not the cavity or the key.

Label channel (cavity word, per-trial) improved to 0.750 at n=16 and is by far the cheapest (45 tok). HIGHFLOW verbalization is Gemma's weak spot in EVERY condition (label 2/4, raw 0/4, iter1 same) — a model-side trait, now thrice-measured.

experiments_done.verdict: Topology + answer key built and measured. Packet v2 AS SPECIFIED loses on both gate halves — reported, not rescued. The translator idea survives only in compact form: the winning channel this round is the cavity's own classification at 45 tokens. Packet v3 must be an order of magnitude smaller or the speed claim stays empty.
